**Operating Temperature Range**

The NE301 is rated for **-20°C to +50°C** in the product page, outdoor deployment guide, and refrigerator monitoring guide, covering cold storage, hot factory floors, and harsh outdoor environments [1][2][3].

**Note on Battery Guidance**

One battery recommendation document states **-20°C to 60°C** for the NE101/NE301 operating range, which conflicts with the -20°C to +50°C figure used elsewhere [4]. The -20°C to +50°C spec is more consistently documented across the official product and deployment materials.
